scientific_limitations: The factorial cardinality bound applies only to transverse zeros; isolated singular zeros can carry higher index. The compact support and exact zero formula hold for the explicitly constructed windows, not arbitrary windows. A general topological zero-count result and polynomial coefficient basis belong to the cited preceding literature; the contribution is their explicit sharp all-positive realization with a parameterized exact Jacobian. No independent validation or exhaustive priority claim is made.
title: Sharp factorial saturation of common Zak zeros by compactly supported windows
